jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established retail organization with a significant presence across Belgium and the Netherlands. Operating a large network of stores, the company serves thousands of customers daily and places technology at the heart of its operational success.As part of an ambitious digital transformation strategy, the organization continuously invests in the modernization of its retail ecosystem, including store operations, customer-facing technologies, and omnichannel capabilities. Technology teams work closely with the business to deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, support growth, and enhance the customer journey.

They are looking for a new Business Consultant focused on Point-of-Sale (POS) systems.

Jobomschrijving

As Business Consultant POS Systems, you will act as the main interface between business stakeholders, store operations teams, external vendors, and IT departments. Your objective will be to ensure the optimal performance, evolution, and support of the organization's Point-of-Sale ecosystem.Your responsibilities will include:

• Gathering, analyzing, and translating business requirements into clear functional specifications.
• Advising stakeholders on system capabilities and process improvement opportunities.
• Documenting business processes, functional requirements, and system enhancements.
• Coordinating change requests, incidents, and developments with external technology partners and vendors.
• Ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of delivered solutions.
• Creating, maintaining, and executing system, integration, and functional test scenarios.
• Supporting business users during testing phases, deployments, and go-live activities.
• Contributing to strategic initiatives focused on innovation, process optimization, and store modernization.
• Configuring and maintaining existing retail applications and POS-related systems.
• Providing second- and third-line application support for complex incidents and operational issues.
• Driving collaboration across technical and non-technical teams to deliver effective and sustainable solutions.
• Identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and enhance the in-store customer experience.

The successful candidate combines strong analytical skills with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology, capable of translating operational needs into effective IT solutions.You are likely to bring:

• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent level of education and experience.
• At least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Application Manager, Business Consultant, or in a similar role.
• Previous experience working with retail, Point-of-Sale (POS), omnichannel, or store operations systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to work.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• The ability to engage with both technical and business audiences.
• A proactive, service-oriented, and customer-focused attitude.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is considered a strong asset.
• A solid understanding of retail processes and the impact of technology on store operations and customer experience.
• Experience with SAP or related enterprise applications would be considered an advantage.
The ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys managing multiple stakeholders, and is motivated by delivering tangible business impact through technology

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.
